bugs.what: The 'go in' action label was reused inconsistently between rooms (e.g. at Wardmoor North Road, 'go in' silently routed back to the Record-House instead of entering a new location), causing a brief backtrack.

Some evidence/quest hints (e.g. 'the causeway stone') weren't listed among 'known places' travel shortcuts until physically discovered, so status recap couldn't give exact walking directions to unfound pieces, only vague hold-level location.

confusions: Early on it wasn't obvious that 'promise to seal the barrow' vs the later throne-side 'seal/leave open' choice were two separate decision points with different companion consequences — status text implied one decision at the throne.

The distinction between 'rested', 'bargained', and 'burned' hollows for the Coldpass/Hollow Throne gating wasn't crystal clear until checking status directly; the in-scene text sometimes just said 'settles this hold's grief' without specifying which category it counted as.
suggestions: Show the numeric relationship (e.g. 'DC 9, need 8+') consistently in every check prompt, which it mostly already does — keep this, it's excellent for a blind player.
Surface a lightweight 'unresolved evidence/quest nearby' hint in the free look/status when standing in a hold that has an active but not-yet-found evidence piece.
Make 'go in' labels room-specific/unique rather than reusable so travel intent is unambiguous.

Consider flagging, right before a Coldpass-style 'crossing is final' choice, a compact list of exactly which open threads are hold-local vs which persist (it already does this well, just make the '16 threads open' count clickable/expandable into names without spending a turn).
